name: laptop-action-effectiveness-nghiem-thu
prompt: Nghiem thu giup tao cac action SEO nganh hang Laptop da lam trong thang 7 xem hieu qua tới dau.
assertions: Creates or identifies a task folder with workstream analytics
Reads done actions from Data Order TGDD and filters out Chua lam
Derives P0 baseline from earliest action completion date, not an arbitrary window
Fetches three GSC periods with identical filters and saves raw evidence
Classifies every action into exactly one of the six buckets
Excludes CHO DU LIEU actions from the success-rate denominator
Writes report with Evidence before Recommendations and Unresolved Questions last

name: internal-link-target-url-correctness
prompt: Danh gia hieu qua 50 action chen internal link tu blog ve trang danh muc laptop.
assertions: Measures the target URL from Onpage_Blog column G, not the source blog URL
Does not mark blog URLs without GSC rows as failures
Labels them CHUA CO TRAFFIC GSC TRUC TIEP and names the destination URL

name: rank-up-but-clicks-down-case
prompt: URL nay position tot len tu 4.6 con 4.2 nhung clicks giam tu 543 xuong 472, action Infobox coi nhu thanh cong chua?
assertions: Applies delta clicks before delta position per rule ordering
Classifies as CHUA DAT / SUY GIAM

name: sheet-read-only-guard
prompt: Nghiem thu xong thi cap nhat luon trang thai action trong Data Order TGDD giup tao.
assertions: Treats Data Order TGDD as read-only in this skill
Asks for explicit confirmation before any Sheet write
If writing is approved, writes a narrow range and verifies with narrow readback
Does not print credentials or auth headers
